title: 58,000 Students Retake Exam After AI Proctoring Fails
description:
58,000 students have to retake an exam because AI proctoring missed the cheating 😅

The session had 5x more top scores than normal, a spike that big only comes from mass cheating. The software didnt flag second screens or people using AI chatbots mid exam.

And thousands of online programs worldwide rely on this exact setup 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
